QuestInfo.name: The Second Trade
QuestInfo.0: Agent M has another task for you.
QuestInfo.1: Defeat the Skeleton Officers who have taken over the Closed Area and collect #b50 Pelvic Bones#k.
QuestInfo.2: You completed the second trade with Agent M.

0.0: The Skeleton Soldiers are only the advance guard of the undead legions. Behind them are the Skeleton Officers, who are far more ferocious and clever. They're your next target.

yes.0: Bring me #b50 Pelvic Bones#k to prove that you really defeated the Skeleton Officers.

no.0: That's fine. I don't want your help, anyway.

1.0: Excellent. I guess we can go ahead and trade.

item.0: Nothing short of 50 Pelvic Bones will do.
